description: Facts about each agent runner are spread over shared structures: AGENT_IMAGE_MAPPING, AGENT_TICKERS and DEFAULT_MODELS in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_defaults.py (five entries each, claude/antigravity/pi/codex/opencode) and the per-agent credential branches of StandardAgentRunner.validate in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_runner.py (a custom_validator string switch for codex and antigravity, plus the claude and pi session-directory table). Adding or dropping an agent edits all of them, so two runner changes always conflict.
goal: A new package apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/runners/ holds one small module per agent (antigravity, claude, pi, codex, opencode), each defining a frozen RunnerSpec (image, default model, ticker or None, api-key environment variables, a check_credentials method that returns None when credentials are present or the error text when not). runners/__init__.py exposes the specs by agent id. AGENT_IMAGE_MAPPING, AGENT_TICKERS and DEFAULT_MODELS in agent_defaults.py become views derived from the specs with identical keys and values to today. StandardAgentRunner.validate resolves credentials, asks the agent's spec to check them and prints the error and exits 1 exactly as today; no per-agent branch or custom_validator switch remains in it. Observable behaviour (messages, exit codes, accepted environment variables and session directories, pi local-LLM exemption, codex HOLON_AGENT_OSS_MODE exemption) is unchanged. The model capability table RUNNER_CAPABILITIES and everything about model discovery stay as they are. The runners package must not import agent_defaults or agent_runner (no import cycle). The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script; every touched module stays within its current budget and every new module stays within the default budget.
rationale: One module per agent makes adding or dropping a runner a one-file change and removes the shared-dictionary edit conflicts between concurrent runner changes.
acceptance_criteria: AGENT_IMAGE_MAPPING, AGENT_TICKERS and DEFAULT_MODELS equal today's dictionaries exactly and are derived from the runner specs; a test pins the expected values.

StandardAgentRunner.validate contains no per-agent branch and no custom_validator string comparison; each spec's check_credentials reproduces the current message and exit behaviour for codex, antigravity, claude, pi and opencode, covered by tests that fail on a missing credential and pass on a key, a session directory or the documented exemptions.
A test asserts that every spec has an image built by apps/sandbox-executor/docker-bake.hcl and a case in apps/sandbox-executor/entrypoint/role_dispatcher.sh (both files are read, not edited).
HOLON_AGENT_KEY remains the only credential variable outside container entrypoints; no new environment variable is introduced.
Importing sandbox_executor.runners does not import agent_defaults or agent_runner.
RUNNER_CAPABILITIES and the model resolution functions are unchanged; no source file outside the scope list changes.
The module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for tests/test_agent_runner.py, tests/test_agent_defaults.py, tests/test_runner_specs.py, tests/test_import_cycle.py and tests/test_naming.py.
